notes.note:
Fixed the dot that marks a tab needing attention being hard to see with some themes, depending on the system accent color. ([Bug 2086347][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086347

Fixed a command prompt window briefly appearing on Windows when Firefox restarts to apply an update. ([Bug 2081809][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2081809

Fixed passkey sign-in failing on websites that share passkeys across related sites, such as Facebook and Instagram. ([Bug 2085450][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2085450

Fixed crashes on Windows that could occur with some antivirus or other security software installed, in some cases also leaving WebGL disabled. ([Bug 2083648][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2083648

Fixed red and blue colors appearing swapped on some websites that use WebGL on Linux, including video call background effects. ([Bug 2087301][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2087301

Updated time zone data to reflect Cuba's decision not to end daylight saving time on November 1, 2026. ([Bug 2086609][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086609

Fixed text in some Settings descriptions, such as security warnings, breaking in the middle of words. ([Bug 2086282][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086282

system_requirements:
## Windows

### Operating Systems (32-bit and 64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  1GB of RAM / 2GB of RAM for the 64-bit version
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later 

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*


- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (glibc 2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (libstdc++ 6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio
